example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বিবাহ অনুষ্ঠানটি সপ্তকাণ্ড রামায়ণের মতো বিরাট ব্যাপার হয়ে উঠেছে।
তার জীবনকাহিনী সপ্তকাণ্ড রামায়ণের মতো বিস্তৃত।
example_sentences_in_english: This wedding ceremony turned out to be a grand affair like the seven chapters of the Ramayana.
His life story is as vast and detailed as the seven chapters of the Ramayana.
history: The idiom draws from Valmiki's Ramayana, an ancient Indian epic divided into seven kandas (books), symbolizing completeness and vastness in storytelling.
note: Refers to the comprehensive nature of the Ramayana epic in Hindu tradition.
